record.paper: Sunflowers in set systems of bounded dimension

dossier_meta.paper: Sunflowers in set systems of bounded dimension
dossier_meta.statement_text: For $d \geq 1$ and $r \geq 3$, there is a constant $C = C(d, r)$ such that $f^d_r(k) \leq C^k$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors note that the Erdős-Rado sunflower conjecture implies this weaker statement about families of bounded VC-dimension $d$, where $f^d_r(k)$ is the minimum family size guaranteeing an $r$-sunflower among $k$-sets with VC-dimension at most $d$. The paper proves the conjecture for $d = 1$ (Theorem 1.2) and establishes the slightly weaker bound $f^d_r(k) \leq 2^{10k(dr)^2 \log^* k}$ for $d \geq 2$ (Theorem 1.3), leaving the full conjecture open for $d \geq 2$.
